editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood spot where fresh tortillas and perfectly seasoned meats shine, with tableside guacamole that steals the show.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation through Resy, especially for lunch and dinner—tables fill up fast. Arrive early or ask your server to bring beans with your order, as they don't come standard.

topDishes.note: A dessert that doesn't disappoint and leaves guests wanting to come back
